description: Versioned DPPA (Direct Power Purchase Agreement) regulatory constants (transmission/distribution loss factors, settlement fee adders), keyed by vintage year. Mirrors evn_tariff_rates.json's pattern. proforma_vietnam/dppa_settlement.py's module constants are initialized from the latest vintage here; proforma_vietnam/defaults/__init__.py's dppa_regulatory_for_year() resolves a requested year to the latest vintage year <= that year.

2025.source: NLDC/EVN 2025 announcements (EVN notice 08/05/2025, provisional); NSMO CD7 worked example
